provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 4808 AIRPORT AVE, ROSENBERG, TX, 77471

food.sponsor: Committed to Healthy Meals Food Program, Inc.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: The operation did not provide proof of completed annual training for the director and caregiver by the original compliance date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Child's allergies and Completed Food Allergy Plan: The operation did not provide proof of a completed food allergy emergency plan for a child with a documented allergy by the compliance date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Child's allergies and Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(15))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: The director and one caregiver did not have proof of the required number of training hours being completed during the most recently completed training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Liability Insurance: The operation was unable to provide proof of current liability insurance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Liability Insurance (26 TAC §746.801(6))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: The operation was unable to provide proof of emergency drills being conducted in 2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Child's allergies and Completed Food Allergy Plan: One child with a diagnosed food allergy listed in admission information did not have a food allergy emergency plan on file at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Child's allergies and Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(15))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2024 data revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2024 by January 15, 2025, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: The operation was unable to provide documentation of fire drills conducted in 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The most recent annual fire inspection was conducted over 12 months ago.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: One caregiver's most recent CPR card expired 3/25/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: One caregiver did not have proof that they had completed all required training topics listed in 1309(e) during the most recently completed training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: The operation was unable to provide proof that maintence checklists had been completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check determination - If ineligible then you must immediately remove subject from operation and confirm to CBCU receipt of notice letter: A caregiver with an ineligible background check was present around children during the inspection.  The individual was removed from the class and placed in the office.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check determination - If ineligible then you must immediately remove subject from operation and confirm to CBCU receipt of notice letter (26 TAC §745.635(2))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: A 16 month old infant was combined with children more than 18 months older during naptime in a room when there was more than 13 children present in the building.    This was corrected when the infant was moved to another room with their own caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: Operation did not complete an incident report once being notified by the parent of a non-routine situation in which the child was taken to the doctor for concerns about injuries observed on the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The operation did not notify Licensing of a non-routine situation in which a child was seen by a doctor for injuries that occurred while the child was in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Sufficient evidence found during DFPS investigation inspection to prove via video that infant room caregivers walked out of the room multiple times leaving infants unattended and caregivers unable to intervene.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: Based on the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support that abused occurred when an infant in care of the operation obtained injuries including bruises and marks that were caused by a caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries: The operation did not notify the parent when they picked up their child of scratches that were observed by center staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver did not demonstrate competency when picking up an infant by one arm to remove the child from the nap cot. Additionally, the caregiver did not demonstrate self-control when interaction with the infant resulted in bruising on the child's arm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: Sufficient evidence found during DFPS investigation inspection to prove via video that a caregiver was using their cell phone for personal use while in direct care of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver was present in the two year old classroom without an eligible background check. She was removed from the classroom during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: The director did not have proof of training being obtained in the following topics during the most recently completed training year: Emergency preparedness; Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, including immunizations; Administering medication, if applicable, including compliance with 746.3803 of this chapter (relating to What authorization must I obtain before administering a medication to a child in my care?); Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction; Understanding building and physical premises safety, including identification and protection from hazards that can cause bodily injury such as electrical hazards, bodies of water, and vehicular traffic; and Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials including compliance with 746.3425 of this chapter (relating to Must caregivers wear gloves when handling blood or bodily fluids containing blood
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: One caregiver did not have proof of completion of 24 hours of training in the most recently completed training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: Two caregivers hired within the last year did not have proof of completed orientation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: A child was able to leave the building during naptime without the caregiver noticing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The operation failed to notify licensing after allowing a child to wander away from the center unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you become aware of anyone requiring a background check under 745.605: A staff without a background check was present around children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you become aware of anyone requiring a background check under 745.605 (26 TAC §745.621(a)(7))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: Based on evidence gathered by the DFPS investigator, a caregiver failed to appropriately supervise a child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The classroom exterior door does not shut completely and allowed a child to leave the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: The operation failed to notify the child?s parents after allowing the child to wander away from the center unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: There were multiple electrical outlets that did not have child proof covers in both toddler classrooms.    *This was corrected by the caregiver covering the electrical outlets inside the classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: There were multiple cups and bottles not labeled with the child's name.    * This was corrected at a=inspection by the caregiver labeling the bottles and cups.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: During inspection, four children under 2 years were watching television.    Note: This was corrected when television was turned off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))
